source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: As the battle begins, pick one of these keywords: **INFANTRY**, **MONSTER**, **MOUNTED** or **VEHICLE**. Whenever this model attacks a unit with the picked keyword, it can re-roll 1s to [Hit](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls) and 1s to [Wound](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls).

combat.unresolved: The rule offers options to select one of, which the reading applies without the option.

detail.trigger: each attack against a unit with chosen keyword
